questions.text:
Analyse how the setting required one or more characters to adapt or change.

"Setting" may refer to physical places as well as social and historical contexts.

Write an essay on at least ONE written text that you have studied, in response to this question. Support the points you make with specific details from the text(s). You should aim to write a concise essay of no more than 4-5 pages.
questions.markingGuide: Achievement (3-4): Present a structured response using essay conventions and analysis-related terminology appropriately. Address the question by exploring how setting forces characters to adapt or change, showing awareness that effects and meanings have been deliberately crafted. Include specific details from the text(s). Merit (5-6): Convincingly address the question, presenting a reasoned discussion showing clear understanding. Show awareness of deliberate crafting for a particular purpose. Weave a range of specific details to support the main idea(s). Excellence (7-8): Develop an insightful or original argument about how setting drives character change, making judgments about how effects and meanings relate to the purpose of the text(s).
